north_star: Which computations let Drosophila transform unreliable chemical evidence into robust odor detection, behavioral meaning, and source-directed action, and which of those computations transfer to engineered smell sensors?

aims.name: geosmin-specialist-calibration
aims.question: Can independently measured Or56a/DA2 biology and audited downstream wiring reproduce known geosmin-channel phenomena without fitting to the headline behavioral benchmark?

aims.name: multi-odor-representation
aims.question: How do odor identity, concentration, and valence become represented across receptor and downstream olfactory stages?

aims.name: odor-conflict-temporal-computation
aims.question: Do independently constrained biological wiring and synaptic dynamics explain held-out odor-conflict and time-resolved behavioral responses better than receptor-only, generic, and matched topology controls?

aims.name: plume-evidence-to-action
aims.question: Does biological olfactory/navigation circuitry improve held-out plume cue integration and source-directed action under independently calibrated dynamics?

aims.name: engineered-sensor-translation
aims.question: Do frozen fly-derived transformations improve odor sensing under concentration, mixture, interferent, drift, and domain shift?

claim_boundaries: Connectivity alone does not establish neural dynamics or causal effect strength.
O001 geosmin presence/absence detection cannot be promoted into the flagship topology-advantage claim.
Engineering transfer in O005 cannot validate the biological mechanism in O001-O004.
Modeled neural activity must never be called recorded or measured neural activity.
A topology advantage supports a constrained computational claim, not a complete simulation of a fly brain.
